caseName: Purdue Pharma L.P. v. United States ex rel. May
caseNameFull: PURDUE PHARMA L.P. v. UNITED STATES EX REL. Steven MAY and Angela Radcliffe.

opinions.text: Motion of The Pharmaceuticals Research and Manufacturers of America, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiaegranted.
